meta.title: This Food SHOCKED US! International Cuisine In Da Nang, Vietnam 🇻🇳
meta.description:
In this video, we show you what it looks like to eat international food in Da Nang, Vietnam. It shocked us! 

After over a year of full time travel eating local food across 9 countries and 2 continents, we can't tell you how nice it was to load some international cuisine into us! The cost of it all shocked us even more! 

Please leave us a comment to say where you're watching from and how much this would have cost in your country!
